title: spec: sys_api_key.revoked_reason gains organization_membership_ended, so the Restore action can refuse a key revoked because its owner left the organization (cloud#3403 follow-up)
body:
repo:cloud#2 · os-zhuang · session_0123kRqqdpAJWYMgsgdAJX4G

Filing gate ①: a follow-up from PR objectstack-ai/cloud#3423 (cloud#3403, merged 2026-10-31 09:22Z). It came out of the pre-GA security pass, cloud#3390.

## 维护者速读

cloud 现在会在成员被移出组织时吊销他在各环境里的 API key。但环境管理员可以通过 Restore 操作把这个 key 恢复。框架里 `sys_api_key.revoked_reason` 目前只接受 `admin_password_reset` 一个值，所以恢复入口分辨不出这是「成员离开组织」导致的吊销。

## Expected

- `revoked_reason` accepts `organization_membership_ended`. That is the framework's own word, already used for sessions as `revoke_reason`.
- The Restore action refuses a key revoked for that reason, or is hidden for it.
- cloud's `/_admin/environments/:id/revoke-identity` then writes the reason.

## Reader who acts

Framework triage (spec plus the `sys_api_key` actions). This is a spec widening, so it goes through the contract-review tier. The cloud half is a one-line write once it lands.

## Dedup

I searched objectstack issues for "revoked_reason membership api key restore": no open card.
